LL=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); cols=LL[0].split(); B62={}
for l in LL[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
AAI={a:i for i,a in enumerate(cols)}
MAT=np.array([[B62[(a,b)] for b in cols] for a in cols],float)
def enc(s): return np.array([AAI.get(c,AAI['X']) for c in s])
def sw(s1,s2,go=11,ge=1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,:]=0; M[:,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2]
        prev=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]])
        k=prev.argmax(0); val=prev.max(0)+s
        neg=val<0; val[neg]=0; k=k.astype(np.int8); k[neg]=3
        M[i,1:]=val; pM[i,1:]=k
        o1=M[i-1,1:]-go; o2=Ix[i-1,1:]-ge
        Ix[i,1:]=np.maximum(o1,o2); pX[i,1:]=np.where(o1>=o2,0,1)
        g=M[i,:]-go+np.arange(m+1)*ge
        run=np.maximum.accumulate(g); arg=np.zeros(m+1,np.int32); bi=0
        for j in range(m+1):
            if g[j]>=g[bi]: bi=j
            arg[j]=bi
        iy=np.full(m+1,NEG); iy[1:]=run[:-1]-np.arange(1,m+1)*ge+ge
        Iy[i,:]=iy; pY[i,1:]=np.where(arg[:-1]==np.arange(m),0,2)
    bi=np.unravel_index(M.argmax(),M.shape)
    i,j=bi; state=0; A=[];Bb=[];Ai=[];Bi=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if state==0:
            if M[i,j]<=0: break
            A.append(s1[i-1]); Bb.append(s2[j-1]); Ai.append(i); Bi.append(j)
            st=int(pM[i,j]); i-=1; j-=1; state=st
            if st==3: break
        elif state==1:
            A.append(s1[i-1]); Bb.append("-"); Ai.append(i); Bi.append(None); state=int(pX[i,j]); i-=1
        else:
            A.append("-"); Bb.append(s2[j-1]); Ai.append(None); Bi.append(j); state=int(pY[i,j]); j-=1
    return M[bi],"".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb)),list(reversed(Ai)),list(reversed(Bi))

ACC={"LRAT":"O95237","PLAAT1":"Q9HDD0","PLAAT2":"Q9NWW9","PLAAT3":"P53816",
     "PLAAT4":"Q9UL19","PLAAT5":"Q96KN8","LRATD1":"Q96KN4","LRATD2":"Q96KN1"}
S={n:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
   for n,a in ACC.items()}
REF="PLAAT3"; CATREF={"H1":23,"H2":35,"Cnuc":113}

blocks={}   # name -> {site: (window_string, center_index_in_window, center_resnum)}
for n in ACC:
    if n==REF:
        blocks[n]={k:(S[REF][p-6:p+5], 5, p, S[REF][p-1]) for k,p in CATREF.items()}
        continue
    _,a1,a2,i1,i2=sw(S[n],S[REF])
    col={p:c for c,p in enumerate(i2) if p is not None}
    d={}
    for k,p in CATREF.items():
        c=col.get(p)
        if c is None: d[k]=("-"*11,5,None,"-")
        else:
            w=a1[max(0,c-5):c+6]
            if len(w)<11: w=w.ljust(11,"-")
            d[k]=(w,5,i1[c],a1[c])
    blocks[n]=d

order=["LRAT","PLAAT1","PLAAT2","PLAAT3","PLAAT4","PLAAT5","LRATD1","LRATD2"]
sites=[("H1","His (LRAT H60 / PLAAT3 H23)"),("H2","His (LRAT H72 / PLAAT3 H35)"),("Cnuc","nucleophile (LRAT C161 / PLAAT3 C113)")]

# ---- ortholog conservation ----
species={"Homo sapiens":9606,"Mus musculus":10090,"Rattus norvegicus":10116,"Bos taurus":9913,
 "Canis lupus familiaris":9615,"Ornithorhynchus anatinus":9258,"Gallus gallus":9031,
 "Alligator mississippiensis":8496,"Xenopus tropicalis":8364,"Danio rerio":7955,
 "Latimeria chalumnae":7897,"Oryzias latipes":8090,"Takifugu rubripes":31033,
 "Sarcophilus harrisii":9305,"Equus caballus":9796,"Sus scrofa":9823}
rows=[]
for sp,tax in species.items():
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":f'(gene:LRATD1 OR gene:FAM84A OR gene:lratd1) AND organism_id:{tax}',
              "format":"json","size":20,"fields":"accession,length,sequence,reviewed"},timeout=40)
    h=[x for x in r.json().get("results",[]) if 230<=x["sequence"]["length"]<=360]
    if not h: continue
    h.sort(key=lambda x:(x["entryType"].startswith("UniProtKB reviewed"),x["sequence"]["length"]),reverse=True)
    rows.append((sp,h[0]["primaryAccession"],h[0]["sequence"]["value"]))
HUM=S["LRATD1"]; POS=[143,155,212]
cons=[]
for sp,acc,sq in rows:
    _,a1,a2,i1,i2=sw(HUM,sq)
    c={p:k for k,p in enumerate(i1) if p is not None}
    pid=100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-')/max(1,sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x!='-' and y!='-'))
    cons.append(dict(species=sp,acc=acc,pid=round(pid,1),**{f"p{p}":(a2[c[p]] if p in c else "?") for p in POS}))
cons=pd.DataFrame(cons)

            fw="bold" if k==ci else "normal"

        if rn: ax.text(xs+0.125,y,str(rn),fontsize=7.5,color="#777777")
